title: Zesty Crunchy Mexican Chicken Tacos
description: A flavorful, crunchy Mexican dish featuring chicken, crispy lettuce, and a zesty chipotle sauce. Perfect for a date-night dinner.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt, black pepper, and a pinch of cumin.
In a blender or food processor, blend the chipotle peppers, mayonnaise, and sour cream until smooth.
Heat 2 tablespoons of lard or vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breasts and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the cooked chicken to a plate and let rest for 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
To assemble the tacos, place a cooked chicken breast on a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of chipotle sauce, some chopped cilantro, and a sprinkle of shredded lettuce and diced red onion.
For the crunchy tortilla strips, heat 1/4 cup of lard or vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Cut the day-old tortillas into thin strips and fry in batches until crispy and golden.
Drain the fried tortilla strips on paper towels and season with salt.
Garnish the tacos with the crunchy tortilla strips and a dollop of sour cream.
